_comment: Checked list of integration test files that stay Unix-only for #521. Each entry names the Unix-only mechanism that still blocks a Windows port (real signal delivery, Unix-domain sockets, PTYs, unix file metadata, or the direct native-execution trust model). Converted files are removed from this list. tools/test_unix_only_tests.py refuses any #![cfg(...unix...)] test file that is not listed here, and refuses stale entries.
applet_executable_pinning.rs: shell applets plus symlink confinement and PATH executable-bit assertions
daemon_cli.rs: product daemon has no Windows transport (imp::serve/stop bail: this build has none); 35/36 tests need a running daemon over AF_UNIX plus unix metadata
demo_walkthrough.rs: fake compositor is a shell script the runtime executes directly (no Windows equivalent), plus program-created symlinks asserted via readlink
fs_deadlines.rs: POSIX mkfifo utility plus unix file-type assertions
issue_524_terminal_stop.rs: PTY with a background process group stopped by SIGTTIN/SIGTTOU; no Windows equivalent of job-control stops
issue_729_retry_backoff.rs: real SIGINT delivery to drive the interrupt drain during a retry backoff
issue_757_recorded_drain.rs: real SIGINT delivery to exercise the drain timeout of a recorded run
issue_89_slow_pipe_diagnostic.rs: Unix write_diagnostic path with a slowly drained stderr pipe (nonblocking descriptor writes)
issue_930_stdin_listener_flags.rs: O_NONBLOCK status flags on a shared stdin description, read with fcntl after SIGKILL
ladder.rs: 150-program unix utility harness with signal/stat-based runner (SIGTERM is only its timeout path); programs assume unix tools
lane_a_demo.rs: fake demo tool is a shell script the runtime executes directly, plus program-created symlinks asserted via read_link
lane_b_drain_signals.rs: real SIGINT delivery to a running program
lane_o_double_interrupt_cleanup.rs: real PTY Ctrl-C with SIGINT process-group semantics
lane_o_terminal.rs: needs a Linux controlling PTY for terminal handoff
live.rs: tests speak AF_UNIX directly (UnixStream + raw JSON lines); product has a Windows named-pipe transport but tests have no pipe client
manifest_trust.rs: symlink/permission/setuid trust assertions with shell applets
model_workflows.rs: 100-workflow unix model harness with process-group timeout kill; workflows assume unix fixtures
staged_helpers.rs: asserts unix nlink/uid/mode single-link executable contract
